title: Yellow Browned Norwegian Lamb Skewers
description: Smoky and juicy lamb skewers with a cozy Norwegian twist, featuring palm sugar and a mirepoix base, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together palm sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the palm sugar mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion, carrot, and celery until tender.
Add the garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Brush the tava griddle with olive oil and cook the lamb skewers for 5 minutes per side.
Serve the lamb skewers with the mirepoix base spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
